backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing user profiles, order creation, storage, and authorization with role checks and blob upload support.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short descriptive summaries for each frontend component and page in the project.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment variable template for local development including backend canister ID and Internet Identity config.
frontend/.env.production: Production environment variable template requiring injected backend canister ID and II URL.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide detailing prerequisites, admin bootstrap, security notes, and steps for deploying to IC mainnet.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color variables and dark mode settings for the frontend theme.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint defining root container, metadata, favicon links, fonts, and script loader.
frontend/scripts/deploy-mainnet.sh: Shell script automating frontend mainnet deployment including env validation, build, and IC asset upload.
frontend/scripts/validate-production-env: Validates production environment by checking VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID and dfx availability before deployment.
frontend/src/@types/html2canvas.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file placeholder for html2canvas.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app entry defining routes, authentication gates, and theme provider using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/AdminGate.tsx: Conditionally renders children only if user is an admin, otherwise shows an access denied screen.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Page layout wrapper providing header, footer, and main content structure.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Protects routes by checking authentication and showing a loading or auth-required screen.
frontend/src/components/AuthRequiredScre: UI screen prompting unauthenticated users to sign in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Sign-in/sign-out button managing Internet Identity auth and navigation.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Top navigation bar with branding, navigation links, and auth/admin actions.
frontend/src/components/IdCardActions.ts: Provides export and print buttons for ID card functionality.
frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Renders a styled preview of an ID card with photo and personal details.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Displays a large novelty watermark overlay for ID previews.
frontend/src/components/NoveltyDisclaime: Banner indicating the ID content is for novelty use only.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCropModal.t: Modal for dragging, scaling, and cropping an uploaded photo to ID aspect ratio.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Image uploader with drag-and-drop, validation, preview, and clear controls.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Displays a state seal image with fallback icon handling when the seal path is missing or fails.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: Exports an array of U.S. state codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Defines static UI copy strings including novelty disclaimers and form text.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAdminResetAl: Mutation hook that clears stored user order mappings and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: Query hook that checks whether the current authenticated user is an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Defines React Query key factories for order and auth queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: Fetches all orders for admin users using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useCreateOrder: Mutation to create an order and update localStorage and user order queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useGetOrder.ts: Fetches a single order by ID using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useUpdateOrder: Mutation to update an order’s status and refresh related order queries.
Retrieves user-specific orders using IDs stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, loading identities and handling login/logout workflows.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with a gothic chrome theme, utility classes, and print rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entrypoint setting up React Query, Internet Identity, and rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin interface listing all orders with controls to update order status and reset all system data.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing their orders with status and navigation to create or view orders.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with hero content and steps explaining how the novelty ID system works.
frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx: Form for creating a new order, collecting ID details, shipping info, and a cropped photo before submission.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Order detail view displaying full ID info, status, photo preview, and related actions.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Sign‑in screen using Internet Identity with login flow and security feature descriptions.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: React page showing an Internet Identity signup intro with feature highlights and a button to navigate to sign‑in.
frontend/src/utils/exportIdCard.ts: Exports or prints an ID card element by rendering it to a canvas/SVG image, with fallback to a print window.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides a helper to capitalize the first letter of an order status string.
frontend/src/utils/stateSeals.ts: Returns the file path for a state seal image based on a US state name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL or session‑persisted parameters, including hash routing support.
frontend/src/utils/username.ts: Empty placeholder file for username utilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining themes, colors, plugins, and extended utilities.
project_state.json: JSON describing project metadata, feature requests, and branding updates for the Falcon IDs site.
